papers.title: Research on Key Technologies of Infrastructure Digitalization based on Multimodal Spatial Data
papers.abstract: Since NASA put forward the concept of the digital twin in 2010, many industries have put forward the dynamic goal of digital development, and the transportation industry is also among them. With more and more companies laying out on this virgin land, the digital twin transportation industry has grown rapidly and gradually formed a complete scientific research system. However, under the largely mature framework, there are still many loophole problems that need to be solved. In the process of constructing a road network with point cloud information, we summarize several major features of the point cloud collected by laser scanners and analyze the potential problems of constructing the network, such as misjudging the feature points as ground points and grid voids. On this basis, we reviewed relevant literature and proposed targeted solutions, such as building a point cloud pyramid modeled after the image pyramid, expanding the virtual grid, etc., applying CSF for ground-point cloud extraction, and constructing a road network model using the PTD (progressive density-based filter) algorithm. For the problem of road sign detection, we optimize the remote sensing data in the ground point cloud by enhancing the information density using edge detection, improving the data quality by removing the low intensity points, and achieving 90% accuracy of road text recognition using PaddleOCR and Densenet. As for the real-time digital twin traffic, we design the P2PRN network using the backbone of MPR-GAN for 2D feature generation and SuperGlue for 2D feature matching, rendering the viewpoints according to the matching optimization points, completing the multimodal matching task after several iterations, and successfully calculating the road camera position with 10° and 15m accuracy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究交通基础设施数字化，与生物打印中的人工智能完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, has no experimental validation related to bioprinting, and does not advance autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 基于多模态空间数据实现交通基础设施数字化。
summary_zh.method: 使用点云金字塔、CSF和PTD算法构建路网，利用PaddleOCR和Densenet识别道路文本。
summary_zh.result: 道路文本识别精度达90%，相机定位精度达10°和15m。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际点云和遥感数据测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve digitalization of transportation infrastructure using multimodal spatial data collected from laser scanners and cameras.
summary_en.method: They applied point cloud pyramid, CSF, and PTD algorithm for ground extraction and road network modeling, and used PaddleOCR with Densenet for text recognition, along with MPR-GAN and SuperGlue for real-time digital twin matching.
summary_en.result: Road text recognition accuracy reached 90%, and camera position estimation achieved 10° and 15m accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The methods were validated on real-world point cloud and remote sensing data with reported accuracy metrics.

papers.title: A comprehensive survey on deep active learning in medical image analysis
papers.abstract: Deep learning has achieved widespread success in medical image analysis, leading to an increasing demand for large-scale expert-annotated medical image datasets. Yet, the high cost of annotating medical images severely hampers the development of deep learning in this field. To reduce annotation costs, active learning aims to select the most informative samples for annotation and train high-performance models with as few labeled samples as possible. In this survey, we review the core methods of active learning, including the evaluation of informativeness and sampling strategy. For the first time, we provide a detailed summary of the integration of active learning with other label-efficient techniques, such as semi-supervised, self-supervised learning, and so on. We also summarize active learning works that are specifically tailored to medical image analysis. Additionally, we conduct a thorough comparative analysis of the performance of different AL methods in medical image analysis with experiments. In the end, we offer our perspectives on the future trends and challenges of active learning and its applications in medical image analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低医学图像分析的标注成本。
summary_zh.method: 综述主动学习核心方法及其与半监督、自监督学习的融合。
summary_zh.result: 提供了主动学习在医学图像分析中的全面概览和性能比较。
summary_zh.validation: 在医学图像基准数据集上进行实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high cost of expert annotation in medical image analysis, this survey reviews deep active learning methods.
summary_en.method: It summarizes core active learning components, including informativeness evaluation and sampling strategies, and their integration with semi-supervised and self-supervised learning.
summary_en.result: The survey provides a comprehensive overview and experimental comparison of active learning methods applied to medical image analysis.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is conducted on benchmark medical image datasets to compare the performance of different active learning methods.
